digest.component_or_area: bridge preview/sync reconciler command routing and lock management
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute one ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit a single manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift detail from that same pass without invoking or reimplementing reconcile-check.

Canonical bridge preview must not acquire, purge, steal, or write the pass lock; it loads a coherent read-only snapshot and produces its manifest lock-free while preserving unrelated repository and lock state byte-identical.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair contract, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and distinct output behavior; it is not aliased to or replaced by preview.

The argparse engine parser must use allow_abbrev=False to reject undocumented prefix abbreviations like --dry-run before any repository access, lock mutation, or reads, while preserving documented --mode dry-run and --mode reconcile-check as valid.

Canonical bridge preview and canonical bridge sync must emit identical field-comparable manifest envelopes; canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally, distinct from legacy uncapped LIVE tally-only behavior.

Legacy uncapped LIVE behavior through CLI, direct engine, library, MCP, older workflows, and external helpers must remain unchanged; capped canonical sync and bootstrap compatibility modes retain existing deterministic applied/deferred contracts.
